pose: IDLE base: upright relaxed body, boots together grounded-neutral, hands resting at sides. Tail curls sideways behind the body instead of streaming upward. Eyes open, calm. No ground.
IDLE breathing second frame: same relaxed upright pose and exact face position, shoulders ONE logical pixel higher, tail tip ONE pixel lower. Very subtle breathing, boots in identical position.
reason: Rejected: tail returned to upward FALL pose; regenerate from idle_00.

pose: DAMAGE impact: very short airborne hit flinch, shoulders lifted, hands drawn inward, eyes briefly squeezed, mouth small. Keep face placement; tail flicked slightly. No sparks.
DAMAGE recovery: relax the flinch slightly, eyes reopening, arms lowering, tail returns toward its usual shape. Same body size and face placement.
DEATH 1 of 4, airborne impact: short shocked expression, hands drawn in, knees softly bent. Remain upright and centered, no ground.
DEATH 2 of 4, airborne curling: curl knees and hands inward below the upright head, eyes close. A compact tucked pose, tail wraps alongside without shrinking.
DEATH 3 of 4, airborne loss of tension: loosen the curl, arms and boots begin hanging, closed eyes, head inclined only slightly, upright readable ears and same face size.
DEATH 4 of 4, airborne final: fully limp but still suspended, closed eyes, arms and feet hanging loosely, head gently tilted. No lying on a floor, no ghost, no particles, no fading baked into pixels.
RUN right-facing frame 1: slight three-quarter face toward RIGHT while retaining both readable eyes; right boot forward, left boot back, arms opposite, tail extending left behind. Small stride.
JUMP_RISE launch pose: upward jump, upright face, one knee slightly lifted and arms close but active, hair and tail trailing DOWN. Boots visible. No jet flame, no flight ability.

GUNBOOTS_FIRE first frame: normal downward falling, boots pulled tightly together pointing DOWN, knees stiffened, hands near sides, tail streams UP. Short firing posture in BODY ONLY. No muzzle flash, projectile, fire or light.

GUNBOOTS_BRAKE normal descent: resist DOWNWARD fall; boots pointing DOWN, knees slightly bent and together, elbows braced, large tail slightly fans UP and sideways. Do not raise boots above the head. No FX.
